translations.web: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.
translations.bsb: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.
translations.kjv: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
